quota.description: Fallback strategy when quota is exceeded
quota.switch_project_desc: Automatically switch to another project when quota is exceeded
quota.switch_preview_model_desc: Switch to preview model version when quota is exceeded
quota.antigravity_credits_desc: Retry once with enabledCreditTypes=["GOOGLE_ONE_AI"] when Antigravity returns quota_exhausted 429
quota.codex_client_desc: Applies only to Codex OAuth credentials with official-clients-only enabled. Protect account quota with a version range, engine fingerprints, and black/whitelists.
quota.codex_client_force_allow_desc: Bypass all Codex client restrictions for emergency compatibility, including the blacklist and fingerprint gate.
quota.codex_client_app_server_desc: Allow third-party clients embedding the Codex engine through app-server. They must still pass the engine fingerprint gate below.
quota.codex_client_fingerprint_desc: Every Required signal must match (AND); slash-separated variants within a row are OR. No Required rows disables the fingerprint gate.
quota.codex_client_signal_placeholder: For example x-codex- or session-id / session_id
quota.codex_client_no_required_warning: No signal is Required, so the engine fingerprint gate is inactive.
quota.codex_client_whitelist_desc: Each rule requires an exact originator and every User-Agent marker to match.
quota.codex_client_blacklist_desc: The blacklist is evaluated first; any populated field match rejects the request.
quota.tail_burst_desc: Prioritize high-concurrency scheduling when an account enters the configured expiry window or its remaining quota falls below the threshold; failures switch to a healthy account with a strong recent success rate.
quota.tail_burst_enabled_desc: The burst lane starts when either the time condition or remaining-quota condition is met.
quota.tail_burst_trigger_percent_hint: Enter the burst lane when remaining quota is at or below this value; it must be greater than 0 and less than 100.
quota.tail_burst_duration_hint: Go duration format, for example 45s or 1m.
quota.tail_burst_tool_injection_desc: Add a tool-call declaration to Codex requests without one so tail-burst scheduling keeps a consistent protocol shape.
quota.cache_affinity_desc: Keeps each session on stable credentials, upstream cache identities, and WebSocket slots to improve prompt-cache hits without extra network work.
quota.cache_affinity_enabled_desc: Enables the independent affinity coordinator. With shadow mode off, affinity decisions affect credential routing.
quota.cache_affinity_shadow_desc: Computes and records affinity decisions without changing actual credential routing; useful before activation.
quota.cache_affinity_max_concurrency_hint: Limits cold requests and new affinity bindings per credential; established warm sessions stay on their current credential and bypass this soft limit.
quota.cache_affinity_max_entries_hint: Capacity of the local session-affinity cache; default 65536.
quota.cache_affinity_max_retry_credentials_hin: Maximum distinct credentials tried after a request failure; default 2.
quota.cache_affinity_websocket_pool_slots_hint: Maps stable sessions to fixed connection slots; range 1–30, default 8.
quota.cache_affinity_max_session_requests_hint: Allows rebinding after this many requests to avoid pinning one credential indefinitely; default 50.
quota.cache_affinity_duration_hint: Go duration format, for example 5m, 30s, or 1h.
quota.cache_affinity_preempt_percent_hint: At this usage level, the credential stops accepting new cold sessions while warm sessions may continue; default 97.
quota.cache_affinity_hard_stop_percent_hint: At this usage level, warm sessions are moved too. Must exceed the preemption threshold and be at most 100.
quota.tail_burst_expiry_window_hint: Enter the burst lane when supplier expiry is within this duration, for example 10m.
quota.tail_burst_max_concurrency_hint: Concurrency ceiling for expiring or low-quota accounts; a higher per-account setting is preserved.
quota.cache_affinity_max_share_percent_hint: 0 disables the cap. For example, 70 sends new cold sessions back to normal routing when cache-affinity selections are about 70% of the recent window; warm sessions and tail-burst behavior stay unchanged.
